target.title: fix(voice-call): guard answered conversation calls when realtime config is absent
target.body:
Closes #100294

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where inbound or outbound voice calls in conversation mode would crash the answered-call handler with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'enabled')` when the voice-call plugin was configured without a `realtime` object. The crash left the call hanging in an answered state with no initial greeting and no listening start.

## Why This Change Was Made

`extensions/voice-call/src/manager.ts:416` read `this.config.realtime.enabled` without optional chaining. Every other reference in the voice-call codebase already uses `config.realtime?.enabled`. The change adds the missing optional-chain guard so an absent `realtime` section is treated as disabled, and the manager proceeds to speak the initial message and start listening as expected. A focused regression test constructs a `CallManager` with `realtime` removed and asserts that answering a conversation call still plays the greeting.

## User Impact

Voice-call setups that do not enable realtime voice-to-voice mode no longer crash on answer; the initial greeting and listening flow start normally.

## Evidence

- Focused local test run (the regression test and the existing notify/conversation suite):

  ```
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/voice-call/src/manager.notify.test.ts --run
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  15 passed (15)
  ```

- The regression test fails before the fix (the answered handler throws and the test times out) and passes after the optional-chaining guard is added.
- `git diff --check` passes; `oxfmt` reports both changed files are correctly formatted.
- No new config surface, dependencies, or backward-incompatible behavior.
